summary: Axalta filed an 8-K supplemental proxy disclosures for its pending acquisition by AkzoNobel. The merger agreement, originally signed Nov 18, 2025, was amended multiple times, with a special meeting scheduled for Aug 5, 2026. Axalta voluntarily supplements the definitive proxy statement. Structural details include two-step merger with AkzoNobel subs, with Axalta surviving first merger then merging into second sub. No price terms disclosed in this excerpt. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory approvals to complete the transaction.
